verdict.rationale: The only on-topic evidence is a sandbox note that developers can "test verification outcomes with magic SSN values." That implies CDP runs its own programmatic identity-verification (KYC) flow that can be exercised through the API, but it is a single thin mention. missing for 10: documented KYC endpoints or flow for customers, KYB for business counterparties, recipient/beneficiary onboarding and verification, gating that blocks sends/receives until a counterparty is cleared, verification status/lifecycle documentation, independent or hands-on corroboration.
